description.zh: 每张卡片同时带有两个维度（颜色、大小、数量、方向中的任意两个），每个维度各有自己的规律。补出空缺那张卡片，需要分别读出两个规律再把它们合在一起。选项是 2×2 诊断矩阵：两个都对、只错第一维、只错第二维、两个都错，因此错在哪一维一目了然。
description.en: Every card carries two dimensions at once (any two of color, size, quantity, direction), each with its own rule. Filling the missing card means reading both rules separately and then combining them. The options form a 2×2 diagnostic matrix — both right, only the first wrong, only the second wrong, both wrong — so it is clear which dimension slipped.

designModel.zh: 主轴是两个维度规律之间的关系：single（只有一个维度在变）→ synced（两个都交替，节奏相同）→ independent（一个交替、另一个持续变大/变多/转动）→ offset-period（一个三拍循环、一个两拍交替，节奏错开），G2 空格位置放开到任意。维度之间从不设交叉规则。
designModel.en: The primary axis is how the two dimensions' rules relate: single (only one dimension changes), synced (both alternate on the same beat), independent (one alternates while the other keeps growing or turning), offset-period (a 3-beat cycle against a 2-beat alternation). At G2 the gap can be anywhere. There are never cross-dimension rules.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 的『一个变一个不变』3-4 岁即可，但仍需要注意到不变的那一维；G2 的错拍节奏约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1's 'one changes, one stays' suits ages 3-4, though it still requires noticing the dimension that does not change; G2's offset rhythms suit about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列，是规律猎手的综合单元：颜色、大小、数量、方向各自的单维规律分别在 color/size/quantity/motion 等模块中练习，本模块只练把两个独立规律同时保持在工作记忆里并整合。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds and is the Pattern Hunter's integration unit: single-dimension rules for color, size, quantity and direction are practised in the color/size/quantity/motion modules; this module only trains holding two independent rules in working memory at once and combining them.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.PATTERN.INTEGRATION.MULTI_DIMENSION，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.PATTERN.INTEGRATION.MULTI_DIMENSION, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: one：只有一个维度在变，另一个恒定（但选项中恒定维度也可能被改错）；two：两个维度都在变。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: one: only one dimension changes and the other is constant (though options may still get the constant one wrong); two: both dimensions change.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: single 只有一条规律；synced 两个维度都是两拍交替；independent 一个交替、另一个是持续变化（大小/数量逐级、方向每次转 90 度）；offset-period 一个三拍循环、一个两拍交替，同一位置的两个值要分别对齐各自的节奏。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: single has one rule; synced has both dimensions alternating on two beats; independent pairs an alternation with a progressive change (size or quantity one step at a time, direction a quarter turn); offset-period pairs a 3-beat cycle with a 2-beat alternation, so each value at a position must be aligned to its own rhythm.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: end 是『下一张是什么』；any 空格可能在中间。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: end asks what comes next; any may put the gap mid-strip.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 5 题，通过线 75%（4/5）。每题的维度组合随机抽取且不与上一题相同。结束时显示『观察力 / 综合力』评分：观察力是两个维度各自答对的比例，综合力是两个维度同时答对的比例。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Five items per run, passing at 75% (4/5). Each item draws a random dimension pair, never the same as the previous item. The end screen shows Observation and Integration scores: Observation is the share of individual dimensions answered right, Integration the share of items with both right.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 一个维度交替、另一个一直不变，选出两样都对的下一张。
levelMap.objectiveEn: One dimension alternates and the other stays the same; pick the next card with both right.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 两个维度都在交替，同时跟住两个维度的节奏。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Both dimensions alternate; follow both rhythms at once.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 一个维度交替，另一个维度持续变大、变多或转动，分别读出两种不同类型的规律。
levelMap.objectiveEn: One dimension alternates while the other keeps growing, increasing or turning; read two different kinds of rule.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 一个维度三拍循环、另一个两拍交替，空格可能在中间，分别对齐两个节奏。
levelMap.objectiveEn: One dimension cycles every 3 and the other alternates every 2, with the gap possibly mid-strip; align each rhythm separately.

statistics.noteZh: optionTypes（both_correct / dim1_wrong / dim2_wrong / both_wrong）直接给出错在哪一维；配合 dimensionPairs 可以看出某个孩子是否总在某一个维度上掉链子。
statistics.noteEn: optionTypes (both_correct / dim1_wrong / dim2_wrong / both_wrong) say directly which dimension went wrong; combined with dimensionPairs this shows whether a child consistently slips on one particular dimension.
